purpose: Audit ledger for every transcript KAT pin touched by the Stage 1 hardening and Stage 2 PCS-scaffold diffs. Each new pin was first observed as the expected failing host KAT, then pinned deliberately, then checked through the SBF SHA-256 syscall path.
repository_state: The first entry is the branch baseline. The remaining entries are named protocol revisions; they are not silent suite-green edits. The v4 entries are explicitly PCS-scaffold evidence, not the final payment-v4 transcript KAT.

entries.reason: Committed pre-Stage-1 transcript: profile, statement, roots/fold challenges, final polynomial, grinding nonce, queries.

Deliberate OOD-binding protocol change: every round adds a root-bound OOD point and absorbs its claimed value before the fold challenge. Exact-uniform rejection sampling also replaced the biased limb map.
Deliberate relation-enforcement protocol change: each OOD value is followed by a claim-mixing challenge and an absorbed degree-6 relation-sumcheck polynomial before alpha.

Deliberate C2 protocol change and envelope-version bump: C1 is absorbed before lambda/chi; C2 is then absorbed; main and helper claimed evaluations are absorbed before gamma; the KAT includes every new squeeze.

First deliberate v4/s=2 PCS-scaffold pin: two sequential beta/y/mu triples per round, but only one C2 helper and one carried helper claim. This exposed the versioned schedule and was then superseded when the normative second helper was added.
